title: Source: the DOD appears to have accepted OpenAI's safety red lines, which were similar to Anthropic's, to deploy OpenAI's tech in classified settings (Maria Curi/Axios)
summary: Maria Curi / Axios: Source: the DOD appears to have accepted OpenAI's safety red lines, which were similar to Anthropic's, to deploy OpenAI's tech in classified settings — - Now, the department, which did not immediately respond to a request for comment, appears to have accepted OpenAI's similar conditions.
